<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/navigation-menu'

import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { ChevronDownIcon } from '@lucide/vue'
import { NavigationMenu } from '@vase-ui/vue/navigation-menu'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { navigationMenuTriggerStyle } from '.'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ NavigationMenuTriggerProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenu.Trigger>
    <template #element="{ props: triggerProps, elementRef, state }">
      <button
        v-bind="triggerProps"
        :ref="elementRef"
        data-slot="navigation-menu-trigger"
        :data-popup-open="state.open ? '' : undefined"
        :class="cn(navigationMenuTriggerStyle(), 'group', props.class)"
      >
        <slot />
        <ChevronDownIcon class="relative top-px ml-1 size-3 transition duration-300 group-data-open/navigation-menu-trigger:rotate-180 group-data-popup-open/navigation-menu-trigger:rotate-180" aria-hidden="true" />

</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { NavigationMenuPositionerProps, NavigationMenuViewportProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/navigation-menu'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { NavigationMenu } from '@vase-ui/vue/navigation-menu'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ NavigationMenuViewportProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  side?: NavigationMenuPositionerProps['side']
  sideOffset?: NavigationMenuPositionerProps['sideOffset']
  align?: NavigationMenuPositionerProps['align']
  alignOffset?: NavigationMenuPositionerProps['alignOffset']
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 8,
  align: 'start',
  alignOffset: 0,
})
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenu.Portal>
    <NavigationMenu.Positioner
      :side="side"
      :side-offset="sideOffset"
      :align="align"
      :align-offset="alignOffset"
      class="ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] data-[side=bottom]:before:top-[-10px] data-[side=bottom]:before:right-0 data-[side=bottom]:before:left-0 isolate z-50 h-(--positioner-height) w-(--positioner-width) max-w-(--available-width) transition-[top,left,right,bottom] duration-[0.35s] data-instant:transition-none"
    >
      <Transition enter-from-class="scale-90 opacity-0" leave-to-class="scale-90 opacity-0 duration-150">
        <NavigationMenu.Popup class="bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-foreground/5 dark:ring-foreground/10 rounded-3xl shadow-lg ring-1 outline-none data-ending-style:scale-90 data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-ending-style:duration-150 data-starting-style:scale-90 data-starting-style:opacity-0 relative h-(--popup-height) w-(--popup-width) origin-(--transform-origin) transition-[opacity,transform,width,height,scale,translate] duration-[0.35s] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]">
          <NavigationMenu.Viewport
            v-bind="$attrs"
            data-slot="navigation-menu-viewport"
            :class="cn('relative size-full overflow-hidden', props.class)"
          />
        </NavigationMenu.Popup>
      </Transition>
    </NavigationMenu.Positioner>
  </NavigationMenu.Portal>
</template>

import { cva } from 'class-variance-authority'

export { default as NavigationMenu } from './NavigationMenu.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuContent } from './NavigationMenuContent.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuIndicator } from './NavigationMenuIndicator.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuItem } from './NavigationMenuItem.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuLink } from './NavigationMenuLink.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuList } from './NavigationMenuList.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuTrigger } from './NavigationMenuTrigger.vue'
export { default as NavigationMenuViewport } from './NavigationMenuViewport.vue'

export const navigationMenuTriggerStyle = cva(
  'hover:bg-muted focus:bg-muted data-open:hover:bg-muted data-open:focus:bg-muted data-open:bg-muted/50 focus-visible:ring-ring/30 data-popup-open:bg-muted/50 data-popup-open:hover:bg-muted rounded-2xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-all focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:outline-1 disabled:opacity-50 group/navigation-menu-trigger inline-flex h-9 w-max items-center justify-center outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none',
)
